title: Spears
content:
# Spears

# Introduction

Spears is a weapon class.
Spears have a fast attack with short range and low stamina cost.
The secondary attack throws the spear, which can be retrieved by the player.

## List of spears

• Name: Flint spear | Damage: Pierce: 20/38 | Stamina (primary): 6 | Stamina (secondary): 8

• Name: Bronze spear | Damage: Pierce: 35/53 | Stamina (primary): 8 | Stamina (secondary): 10

• Name: Ancient bark spear | Damage: Pierce: 55/73 | Stamina (primary): 10 | Stamina (secondary): 12

• Name: Fang spear | Damage: Pierce: 75/93 | Stamina (primary): 12 | Stamina (secondary): 14

• Name: Carapace spear | Damage: Pierce: 115/133 | Stamina (primary): 16 | Stamina (secondary): 18

• Name: Splitnir | Damage: Pierce: 135/153 | Stamina (primary): 16 | Stamina (secondary): 18

## Properties

• Attack type: Spears (primary) | Stamina: 1x | Range: 1.9 m | Attack speed: 0.68 s | Damage: 1x | Staggering: 1x | Knockback: 20 | Notes: Player moves forward 0.33m. 40 degree arc. No 3-hit combo.

• Attack type: Spears (secondary) | Stamina: 1x + 2 | Range: Thrown | Attack speed: 1.04 s (includes picking up) | Damage: 1.5x | Staggering: 1x | Knockback: 1.5x | Notes: Throws the spear. Can be picked up afterward. Floats on water.

Categorias: Weapons, Spears
